meaning:
κατα-μένω
[in LXX for יָשַׁב (Num.20:1, al.), etc. ;]
to remain permanently, abide: Act.1:13, 1Co.16:6, WH (παραμ-, T, EV).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew…
